scope.description: Two trials on real four-voter clusters with one voter demoted to nonvoter through DemoteVoter: the interrupted trial partitions the leader together with the nonvoter and the control partitions the leader alone. Each trial verifies the healthy leader, applies the partition, polls the exported verification path while the leader is still confirmable, keeps watching until the detached voters report their own leader, and reports the last confirmation's and the competing leader's elapsed times on the same clock together with the competing leader's commit index and the cut-off leader's applied index.
assumptions: Captured in-memory timeouts are used, so the lease and election relations are the ones the target's own tests run with; the leader lease is shorter than the election timeout in this configuration, which is a property of the configuration and is reported through the timeline rather than assumed.
The verification is driven through the same channel the exported VerifyLeader API uses, with a bounded wait per poll; polls stop as soon as the leader is no longer confirmable.

The competing leader is identified by which raft instance reports Leader among the two voters that were detached from the interrupted leader, and the observation window for it is 3s, which is longer than this cluster's election time.
excluded: No application-level read is served in this harness; the measurement is about the confirmation and the competing leader's existence, not about what an application would return.
No on-disk store, no network transport and no synthetic request injection.

parameters.trials: trial 0 leader partitioned with the nonvoter; trial 1 leader partitioned alone
parameters.recorded_operands: polls, confirmations, confirmations_after_peer_leader, last_confirmation_ms, first_peer_leader_ms, confirmation_precedes_peer_leader, leader_stepped_down, leader_term, nonvoter_term, leader_applied_index, peer_write_index, peer_commit_index

basis.prefix: Each trial builds a real four-voter cluster with the captured in-memory timeouts, demotes one follower to nonvoter with DemoteVoter and waits until the configuration shows it without a vote, verifies the healthy leader once, applies one command, and then applies the partition (leader with the nonvoter, or leader alone for the control). It polls the verification path every 5ms while the leader reports Leader, recording each outcome, and stops when the leader is no longer confirmable or steps down. It then keeps watching for up to 3s until one of the two detached voters reports Leader, recording when that happened on the same clock, has it commit one entry, and finally emits one summary event carrying the poll counts, the last confirmation's elapsed time, the competing leader's elapsed time, whether the confirmation preceded that leader, and the competing leader's commit index against the cut-off leader's applied index. Only the TestAssurance-prefixed test in this harness is selected and no production file is modified.

comparisons.description: With the captured timers, the last successful confirmation on the cut-off leader comes before the detached voters' leader appears, so the confirmation window does not overlap a competing leader in this configuration.
Control: with the nonvoter also cut off the leader obtains no confirmation at all before stepping down.
